te: Private sector heard on its experience in developing older persons
se: The meeting considered approaches to labour development in an ageing society, hearing a private sector representative, who proposed looking at the differing potential of older persons rather than treating them as a single group, and dividing older persons into 3 groups according to their readiness
it: Approaches to labour development in an ageing society: the private sector's view

te: Proposals heard on turning special groups from a burden into an economic force
se: The meeting considered approaches to labour development in an ageing society, hearing experts on the employment situation, problems and limits, and strategic proposals for special groups, namely older persons, persons with disabilities, students and foreign workers, to turn them from a budget burden into a force driving the economy
it: Approaches to labour development in an ageing society

te: Schedule set for a labour study visit to Prachuap Khiri Khan
se: The meeting considered the schedule of a study visit to Prachuap Khiri Khan Province on 27–29 May 2026, to hear about labour management in the area by the public sector, the private sector and community enterprises, with a focus on job placement and promoting employment
it: Schedule of the study visit to Prachuap Khiri Khan Province (27–29 May 2026)

te: Framework set for studying the law on employing older persons
se: The meeting considered the duties and framework of the working group studying the law on employing older persons and post-retirement workers, as Thailand has become a fully aged society and older persons still have potential and experience, while current labour law may not yet fit the ways older persons are employed, in terms of employee status, rights, protection, welfare and incentives for employers
it: Duties and working framework of the working group studying the law on employing older persons and post-retirement workers

te: Results of the study visit to the national job fair noted
se: The meeting noted the results of the study visit to the job fair at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center on 16 January 2026, which brought together more than 500,000 job vacancies in Thailand and abroad, with skills and vocational training activities for every age group, from students and working-age people to older persons and persons with disabilities, for use in the committee's work
it: Results of the study visit to the job fair (16 January 2026)

te: Work in 2025 summarised, and approaches for 2026 set
se: The meeting summarised its work in 2025, when it continued to study job placement and skills development by inviting agencies to give information, making site visits, holding seminars and forums, and gathering the facts of petitions, and considered its approach to work in 2026
it: Summary of work in 2025 and approaches for 2026

te: Approaches to setting up a labour bank considered (continued)
se: Agenda: the meeting will continue to consider approaches to setting up a labour bank, inviting representatives of the Social Security Office, the Thailand Development Research Institute and state financial institutions to give information
it: Approaches to setting up a labour bank

te: Approaches to setting up a labour bank studied
se: The meeting considered approaches to setting up a labour bank, so that workers and insured persons can reach fair sources of small-scale finance, rely less on informal debt and save more
it: Approaches to setting up a labour bank

te: Meeting summary video · Approaches to setting up a labour bank studied
Agencies heard on moving medical care entitlements
se: The meeting considered moving insured persons' medical care benefits to the Universal Coverage Scheme, inviting representatives of the Social Security Office, the National Health Security Office and the Thailand Development Research Institute to give information and views
it: Moving insured persons' medical care benefits to the Universal Coverage Scheme

te: Academics heard on medical care entitlements
se: The meeting considered moving insured persons' medical care benefits to the Universal Coverage Scheme, hearing the views of health system academics, for use in preparing its recommendations
it: Moving insured persons' medical care benefits to the Universal Coverage Scheme

te: Study of moving insured persons' medical care entitlements (continued)
se: The meeting continued to consider moving insured persons' medical care benefits to the Universal Coverage Scheme, hearing information from the agencies concerned
it: Moving insured persons' medical care benefits to the Universal Coverage Scheme

te: Study begins on moving insured persons' medical care entitlements
se: The meeting considered moving insured persons' medical care benefits to the Universal Coverage Scheme (the "gold card"), hearing the views of representatives of the Senate's subcommittee on public health, to study the advantages, limits and effects on insured persons
it: Moving insured persons' medical care benefits to the Universal Coverage Scheme

te: Seminar prepared on restructuring the Social Security Office
se: The meeting considered holding a seminar on restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office on 16 August 2026, and discussed the idea of an integrated health system for insured persons
it: Seminar on restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office (16 August 2026)
The idea of an integrated health system

te: Work reported, and a study visit to the Government Pension Fund prepared
se: The Chair of the subcommittee, who is the First Vice-Chair of the Committee on Labour, reported on its work. The meeting prepared a study visit to the Government Pension Fund on 9 July 2026, and considered a petition asking for the pension formula for insured persons under section 39 to be amended
it: Preparing the study visit to the Government Pension Fund (9 July 2026)
Petition asking for the pension formula for insured persons under section 39 to be amended

te: Study of restructuring the Social Security Office (continued)
se: The meeting continued to consider restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office, hearing information from the agencies concerned, including approaches to managing funds that already exist in Thailand, for use in its recommendations
it: Restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office
